A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''woman''' who was married to a [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's father/Legends|man]] gave birth to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. She gave her son to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] when he was a [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], or a very young child. Kenobi's memories of her included her wearing a floral perfume, wearing roughly woven [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]], and speaking with a soft voice.
